author: Jo Ransford
content:
I cannot recommend Andy and his team enough, professional and great value for money .
Andy went the extra mile when completing my house removals . The weather was against us as it was very wet, but nothing phased him .
Nothing was too much trouble.
I also purchased several items from their shop , they have some great , interesting items.
The bed shop is great , with lots of different styles and qualities. My bed , I purchased is excellent in comfort and price.
My entire experience with Andy and Sally was perfect . Highly recommend.
